idea-plugin.name: SaltStack Toolkit
idea-plugin.description:
SaltStack Toolkit

Comprehensive SaltStack support for IntelliJ-based IDEs: syntax highlighting, inspections, formatting, navigation, completion and snippets for SLS and Jinja2 files.

Compatible with IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, GoLand, WebStorm, RubyMine, RustRover, CLion and other IntelliJ Platform IDEs (2024.1+).

Features

Syntax highlighting

  • SLS files (.sls) — YAML structure with embedded Jinja
  • Jinja2 files (.jinja, .j2, .jinja2)
  • Configurable colors via Settings → Editor → Color Scheme → SaltStack Toolkit

Inspections (real-time linter)

  • Duplicate top-level keys (state IDs in state files, pillar keys in pillar files)
  • Unclosed Jinja blocks ({% if %} without {% endif %}, etc.)
  • Tab characters (Salt/YAML requires spaces)
  • Trailing whitespace
  • Empty state blocks (state ID without module call)
  • Requisite references to non-existent state IDs in the same file

Formatting

  • Auto-format on save (toggle in settings)
  • Manual format via Shift+Alt+F
  • Enforces {%- on opening Jinja tags (configurable)
  • Preserves closing -%} for explicit whitespace control
  • Tag spacing normalization: {%if x%} → {%- if x %}, {{var}} → {{ var }}
  • Comments {# ... #} content is left untouched
  • Tabs to spaces, trailing whitespace removal
  • Collapses multiple blank lines, ensures final newline

Navigation

  • Structure View (Cmd+7) — outline of state IDs, includes, Jinja imports/variables
  • Go-to-Definition (Cmd+Click):
    • Jinja imports: {% from "formula/map.jinja" import ... %}
    • Jinja includes: {% include "..." %}
    • salt:// source references
    • SLS includes: - .substate, - formula.substate
    • Pillar includes
    • Requisite references inside the current file
    • Reverse navigation: click on a top-level pillar key → find all usages (pillar.KEY, pillar['KEY'], pillar.get('KEY')) in state files
  • Hover documentation for 50+ state modules, all requisites, Salt builtins, execution modules (sdb.get, defaults.merge, fast_yaml.hosts, etc.)

Auto-completion

  • 50+ state modules (file.managed, service.running, etc.)
  • Module parameters (context-aware — suggests parameters of the parent module)
  • All requisites (require, watch, onchanges, etc.)
  • Salt execution modules inside salt[...] and salt.

Live Templates (snippets)

40+ snippets for common Salt patterns:

  • State modules: file.managed, pkg.installed, service.running, cmd.run, user.present, cron.present, git.latest, docker_container.running, archive.extracted, etc.
  • Jinja constructs: if, ifelse, for, set, from, import, include, macro, block
  • Salt patterns: map.jinja, sdb.get, defaults.merge, grains.filter_by, saltutil.runner, pillar.get
  • Boilerplates: sls-boilerplate, sls-full

Configuration

Settings → Tools → SaltStack Toolkit:

  • State roots / Pillar roots — comma-separated paths (relative or absolute) for navigation resolution
  • Toggle individual lint checks
  • Toggle auto-format on save
  • Toggle {%- dash enforcement

idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.5.0

Pillar navigation overhaul

  • Nested key paths — Cmd+Click on any pillar key (top-level or nested) now finds usages by full YAML path. Click on data: inside netbox: > data: searches for pillar.netbox.data (and deeper).
  • Local Jinja aliases — detects {% set foo = pillar.x %} and tracks foo.y references as pillar.x.y.
  • Cross-file dict maps — detects {% set bar = { 'key': pillar.foo.key } %} in one file and {% from "X.jinja" import bar %} in another, then resolves bar.key references back to pillar.foo.key across files.

Pillar hover with state.apply

When hovering over a pillar key in a pillar file, the popup now shows:

  • Full YAML key path
  • All access forms (pillar.x.y, pillar['x']['y'], salt['pillar.get']('x:y'))
  • List of state formulas that consume this key, with ready-to-run salt '<minion>' state.apply <formula> commands and per-formula usage counts

Performance

  • Two-level cache for pillar usage search:
    • File list cache (invalidated on file create/delete or stateRoots change)
    • Per-file content + analysis cache with mtime check (invalidated on file save/change)
  • Subsequent searches with unchanged files skip disk reads entirely.

1.4.1

  • Fix: settings (state/pillar roots, toggles) now persist correctly after Apply/OK.

1.4.0

  • Initial release for JetBrains IDEs.
  • Syntax highlighting, inspections, formatting, navigation, completion, hover, live templates.
  • Settings panel with configurable State/Pillar roots and lint toggles.
